dialogues.speaker: Tablet Text
dialogues.text: (The stone tablet has some intelligible words on it that say...)

dialogues.speaker: Tablet Text
dialogues.text: My father told me that everything we do should be backed up by morality and brought forth with elegance.

dialogues.speaker: Tablet Text
dialogues.text: That's why he said that I should use these words to record hints for my labyrinth.

dialogues.speaker: Tablet Text
dialogues.text: Only within Evernight will the mechanisms to the labyrinth walls and the way forward appear, bathed in invisible moonlight as they are.

dialogues.speaker: Tablet Text
dialogues.text: The mechanisms that control the solution to this labyrinth are hidden in its four corners.

dialogues.speaker: Tablet Text
dialogues.text: And because I lacked rhyme or rhetoric in my writing at the end...

dialogues.speaker: Tablet Text
dialogues.text: My father, Eurydates, gave me a few strokes on the backside with his crutches.
